name: helm-chart
title: Helm chart
blurb: A Kubernetes Helm chart: schema-validated values, named templates, a hardened deployment, and lint/template checks that need no cluster

verify.name: render
verify.cmd: helm template ci-release . --namespace ci > .rendered.yaml && grep -q "kind: Deployment" .rendered.yaml && grep -q "kind: Service" .rendered.yaml && grep -q "kind: ServiceAccount" .rendered.yaml && rm -f .rendered.yaml && echo "rendered ok"

verify.name: values-plumbing
verify.cmd: helm template ci-release . --set replicaCount=5 | grep -qE "^  replicas: 5$" && echo "values reach the manifest"

verify.name: schema-rejects
verify.cmd: helm template ci-release . --set replicaCount=0 >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0 && echo "schema rejected replicaCount=0"

verify.name: test-hook
verify.cmd: helm template ci-release . --show-only templates/tests/test-connection.yaml | grep -q "kind: Pod" && helm template ci-release . --show-only templates/tests/test-connection.yaml | grep -q "helm.sh/hook" && echo "test hook renders"

verify.name: release-names
verify.cmd: helm template myrel . | grep -qE "^  name: myrel-" && helm template myrel . | grep -q "app.kubernetes.io/instance: myrel" && echo "release name is plumbed"

verify.name: hardening
verify.cmd: helm template ci-release . | grep -q "readOnlyRootFilesystem: true" && helm template ci-release . | grep -q "runAsNonRoot: true" && helm template ci-release . | grep -q "automountServiceAccountToken: false" && echo "hardened defaults"
